_comment: Slither configuration for the SRX Token suite. Tuned to suppress framework-noise and surface findings that matter.
_detectors_to_exclude_rationale: naming-convention: OZ + LayerZero use conventions Slither doesn't recognize; not relevant
solc-version: locked to ^0.8.24 intentionally; not a finding
assembly: LayerZero V2 OFT base uses assembly internally; not our code
low-level-calls: BuybackBurner uses .call by design (swap calldata); reviewed in audit
calls-loop: PreSaleRound batchDeployVaults intentionally loops; capped + paginated

8 Oct 2026: arbitrary-send-erc20, arbitrary-send-eth and reentrancy-no-eth are no longer excluded repo-wide; each existing occurrence carries its own dated slither-disable-next-line reason, so a NEW occurrence fails CI (board 656063d0).
16 Oct 2026 (internal audit): unused-state is no longer excluded. Its reason (UUPS __gap arrays) ended with REG-53, and run without the exclusion it reports nothing.
_filter_paths_rationale: Skip dependencies, test stubs, mocks, Foundry test code and the Echidna harness. contracts/echidna is test code by SECURITY.md's own definition; it sits under contracts/ only so Hardhat compiles it, and its unchecked-transfer finding failed CI on every push from 10 Sep 2026 while no deployable contract was affected. The finding itself was also fixed in the harness.
